html:
nnInteractive (DKFZ): a promptable 3D segmenter: click a point, draw a box or a scribble on any structure in a CT, MRI, PET or microscopy volume and it returns that structure's 3D mask; further prompts (positive or negative) refine it. Non-commercial weights (CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0).

Commercial use: no (weights: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0).

Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nnInteractive at 6bf57adf42ca
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/MIC-DKFZ/nnInteractive/blob/3f308d751c00644e4fde6f09c600264b393b21b5/nnInteractive_v1.0/LICENSE ; https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/nnInteractive/blob/master/LICENSE
  • Training data: 120+ volumetric 3D datasets (CT, MRI, PET, 3D microscopy; readme) with simulated prompts.
  • Kernel libraries: vol_norm
  • Variants: nninteractive
  • Outputs: mask
  • Input size: any D x H x W volume and its voxel spacing (resampled to the model spacing, sliding window)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): nninteractive 512x512x512 voxels (5.7 GiB peak allocated, 6.1 reserved)
  • nninteractive 200x200, first call: portable + torch.compile 18 s (cold Inductor cache).
  • nninteractive 192x192, first call: TensorRT fp16 58 s (ONNX + engine).
  • nninteractive portable 200x200, kernels 200x200: Prepares each 3D patch directly in the CUDA network layout. Identical prompt-session masks on synthetic and three labeled CT cases in both CUDA modes.
  • nninteractive portable 192x192: Portable timing measured separately at the TensorRT comparison's input shape, precision and prepared 8-channel 192×192×192 network patch scope.
  • nninteractive load / first call: original 3.23 s / 1.038 s, portable 1.09 s / 0.482 s, kernels 0.65 s / 0.403 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

A small subset of real CT cases of the TotalSegmentator dataset (not the full test split), each run at its card's spacing (1.5 or 3 mm) in the same pipeline; mean over the cases of the Dice (0 to 1) averaged over the classes present, against the ground-truth segmentations (vertebrae_L6 of the subset has no counterpart and is skipped). Original = TotalSegmentator 2.18.0, default fp16 autocast. nnInteractive: per case 12 simulated prompts (point, box, scribble, point + box on 3 organs), one interaction each; Dice of the predicted mask against the ground-truth organ mask, mean over the runs. Agreement is Dice against the original FP16 or portable FP16 mask as labelled. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.003 and p99 <= 0.5 (absolute error of the output mask).

Limitations

  • On the RTX 5060 Ti, preparing a 192³ network patch at 2.25× AutoZoom took 43.2 ms and 2,575 MiB peak allocation, down from 50.9 ms and 5,081 MiB on the same synthetic session state. Tested zoomed patches and prompted CT masks matched bit for bit in the paired runs.
